# LLMs.txt for DiamondAudioCity.com

This file describes the content and structure of DiamondAudioCity.com.
DiamondAudioCity.com provides free online audio tools, calculators, and resources for musicians, audio engineers, DJs, and anyone working with audio. The site offers tools for audio editing, music theory, sound analysis, speaker design, and DJ/music production. The primary purpose is to provide helpful and accessible tools for audio-related tasks.
